description: Retrieve native XRPL amm_info for an AMM. Identify the pool with amm_account, or with an asset+asset2 pair. Use ledger_hash or ledger_index to pin the lookup to a specific ledger. Returns pool balances, LP token supply, trading fee, auction slot, and vote slots when present.

account.description: Optional XRPL account used by the native AMM lookup when applicable.
account.title: Account

amm_account.description: Optional AMM account address identifying the specific AMM ledger object.
amm_account.title: Amm Account

asset.description: First AMM asset specification using an XRPL currency object.
asset.title: Asset

asset2.description: Second AMM asset specification paired with asset.
asset2.title: Asset2

ledger_hash.description: Optional ledger hash used to pin the AMM lookup to a specific ledger.
ledger_hash.title: Ledger Hash

ledger_index.description: Optional ledger index or selector used to pin the lookup to a specific ledger.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

name: n9t2_xrpl_get_amm_info
